sentences.text: Shri Rajesh Joshi, learned Public Prosecutor for the non-applicant - State.
Heard on the question of admission.
Admit.

Also heard on I.A. No.7311/2022, which is an application filed under Section 397(2) of Cr.P.C. for grant of suspension of jail sentence filed on behalf of the applicant - DharmChand S/o Bhashilal Jain.

Ap p lic ant has been convicted under Sections16(1)(A)(1) of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act and sentenced him to undergo 6 months RI with fine of Rs.1000/- with default stipulations vide judgement dated 05.05.2022 passed by the Additional Sessions Judge, Jawad, Distt eemuch in Criminal Appeal No.40/2018 affirming the order dated 11.10.2018 passed by the Judicial Magistrate First Class, Jawad, Distt Neemuch in RCT Case No.223/2011.

entities.text: Judicial Magistrate First Class, Jawad, Distt Neemuch
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the matter.
Applicant was on bail during trial and did not misuse the liberty granted to him.
Learned Trial Court has not properly appreciated the evidence placed on record and there is no likelihood of hearing of revision in near future.
Hence, prays that application for suspension of sentence be allowed.
Learned Public Prosecutor for the non-applicant/State opposes the prayer for suspension of remaining jail sentence and grant of bail to the applicant.

Looking to the short term of sentence and considering other facts and circumstances of the case, this Court is of the considered view that it is a fit case for suspension of the sentence and grant of bail to the applicant.
Hence, without expressing any opinion on merits of the matter I.A.No.7311/2022 is allowed and jail sentence of the applicant shall remain suspended.

I t is directed that subject to depositing the fine amount, if already not deposited, he shall be released on bail, on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty thousand Dharmchand vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 November, 2022 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/149472287/
1 only)

alongwith a solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of Trial Court, for his appearance before the Registry of this Court firstly on 04.01.2023 and on such other dates, as may be fixed by the Registry in this regard, till final disposal of this revision.
List for final hearing in due course.
Certified copy, as per Rules.

(SATYENDRA KUMAR SINGH) JUDGE Vibha Dharmchand vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 November, 2022 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/149472287/
